newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Prasidha's unit to open coffee plant.
newsitem.headline: Prasidha's unit to open coffee plant.

text.p: Indonesia's trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga said on Monday subsidiary PT Aneka Coffee Industry planned to open a new $23 million instant and powder coffee plant in March.
"We expect our subsidiary to start commercial production in March," Prasidha's corporate secretary Arief Petrus told Reuters.

Prasidha owns a 65-percent stake in Aneka Coffee Industry, Japanese firms Itochu Corp and Ueshima Coffee Company own 20 percent and five percent respectively, and local firm PT Citra Buana Tunggal Prakarsa owns 10 percent, Arief said.
